notes.title: V1.2.2 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Everyone! 
This is Asteroid Studio. Because of vocation during Chinese New Year, we are very sorry that this patch is a bit late. And Thanks for feedback from the community, it really helped a lot! Love all of you, Guys!

(Some fixes about Level Effect and Mods need restarting a game.)

V1.2.2

Change:
[list]
[*] Level Effect ”Coward Turtle” will not work on Elite Enemy Vari or Spaceship "Great Again". This Level Effect which modifies damage base on moving speed of enemies, deals unexpected damage to these two Elites. (Vari, Spaceship "Great Again": Man, we can not move at all...)
[/list]

Interface:
[list]
[*] Adjusted some UI elements.
[/list]

Bug Fix:
[list]
[*] Fixed - All effects about reducing enemies’ moving speed do not work. 
[*] Fixed - When using Level Effect “All Access”, covered ground will vanish if you continue a game.
[*] Fixed - When using Level Effect ”Tradition”, turrets cannot be deployed on 1X1 Platform.
[*] Fixed - When merging “Golden Sundial”, Gold cost is wrong.
[*] Fixed - If you abandon a run when selecting Mods and start a new game, you can select mods which is from last run.
[*] Fixed - In Lottery page, right sidebar, which shows details, is displayed abnormally.
[*] Fixed - In Preparation page or Handbook page, names of some gear is displayed incompletely.
[*] Fixed - Descriptions of Polux the Star Prisoner and Vari are English even if you play in Chinese language.
[*] Fixed - some UI elements in Preparation - Level Effect page are displayed abnormally.
[*] Fixed - some text in Merge page during a game are displayed abnormally.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
Greetings!

This is Asteroid Studio. Fortunately, we managed to complete Version 1.2 before Chinese New Year (Most important festival for us Chinese). And members of Asteroid Studio will go back home and take a short vocation. Hope you can enjoy new version of Variables2. And, Happy Chinese New Year!

New Content:
[list]
[*] Add 9 new Level Effects.
[*] Add 13 new Elite Enemies.
[*] Add 13 new Mods.
[*] Add several new Gear.
[/list]

UI:

[/list]

Optimize:

[*] Fixed a bug that Cheating Cat's Loaded Dice occasionally did not work.

[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
Greetings!

This is Asteroid Studio. We have received over 200 comments since Variables2 released. Thank you for supporting! We release version 1.1 today according to our update schedule.(Okay, it is a bit late...) More turrets, more mods, more gear [strike]and I hope there will not be more bugs[/strike] awaits. Hope you can enjoy them.

V1.1.0
New Content:
[list]
[*] Every turret has its own name now, not only a code name.
[*] Add 9 new turrets of various traits:
[list]
[*] Scourage Totem: Immoblize enemies.
[*] Golden Sundial: Produce gold.
[*] Escalator Combo: Provide a conveyer belt.
[*] Assault Ammo Box: Enhance Attack of other turrets.
[*] Holo Scanner: Enhance range of other turrets.
[*] Weakpoint Analyser: Make enemies suffer more damage.
[*] Catalyst Pool: Enhance acid damage.
[*] Etch Processor: Enhance acid damage.
[*] Chordal Ballista: Share gear with other Chordal Ballistas.
[/list]
[*] Add 6 new gears.
[*] Add 12 new achievements.
[*] Add several new Upgrades.
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*] Extended Barrel: Attack Range +6 → 4.
[*] Curvature Rifling: Crit Damage +2000% → 1500%.
[*] Eight-ball: Range +2 → 1.
[*] Auto-Learning Chip: Precision: 5% inherited → 3% inherited.
[*] Auto-Learning Chip: Weakness: 5% inherited → 3% inherited.
[*] Eightie’s Women Clothing: Effect of gaining range can stack up to 5 times per wave.
[*] Vile Crabapple: Range -3 → 2.
[*] Double Armor: Magazine Capacity +10 → 9.
[*] Height Detector: When total damage is more than 10000, Range +1 → 2.
[*] When total damage is more than 50000, Range +2 → 1.
[/list]

Optimize:
[list]
[*] You don’t need to click achievement icon to get reward anymore.
[*] Optimize operation of deploying constructs.
[*] Remind when a construct is deployed on a unavailable place has more details now.
[*] When you unlock Golden Chicken Wuss, you will not gain Chicken Wuss anymore.
[*] When broken battle savedatas are detected, there will be a message box to remind you and you can delete broken battle savedatas.
[*] During battle, you can check Mod Shard prepared by taskbar button “Overall” at any time.
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] Remake most of UI in battle.
[*] You can press ESC key to close pages or open config page in battle.
[*] Banner at the top of screen can be switch or hide by taskbar button “Enemy”/”Merge”/”Overall”.
[*] Add some UI transitions.
[*] Icons of enemies from Golden/Diamond Spawners have special frames now.
[/list]

VFX:
[list]
[*] Add a VFX when enemies are immoblized.
[*] Fixed model and VFX of Slowing Module.
[*] Changed models of enemies from Golden/Diamond Spawners.
[*] Changed VFX of N-type turrets.
[*] Fixed a VFX of fog.
[*] Fixed VFX of deployment and remove.
[*] Fixed VFX of enemies movement.
[/list]

Bug:
[list]
[*] Fixed abnormal data if OS region is some European counties.(Thank you,  @aassii)
[*] Fixed a pathfinding problem of enemies from Golden/Diamond Spawners.
[*] Fixed wrong range of P-type turret.
[*] Fixed abnormal result when Helper's Medal is equipped by a big-sized turret.
[*] Designer is so forgetful that he did not remember that T-type turret cannot attack enemies on same floor. Now it is fixed.
[*] Fixed bug that merge of T-type turrets and W-type turrets.
[*] Fixed wrong description of Multiverse Crystal Ball.
[*] Fixed a FPS dropping problem when you use Butterfly Dream.
[*] Fixed problem that preview of gear next gained.
[/list]

When you update to v1.1.0, expired battle savedata is not available anymore. When you enter game you will get remind and delete your savedata. You need to start a new battle. Of course, it will not ruin those you have unlocked.

notes.title: Some Update logs, And some Q&A
notes.content:
Hi, Everyone! I am OAB, member of Asteroid Game Studio. There has been 1 week since Variables2 released and we have received over 100 comments. Thank you for supporting! We know that there still be number of bugs and UI problems in our new game. We are sorry for that and working on solve those annoying problems. 

Until now(v1.0.7), we

-Fix mistakes in description of some Constructs.
-Fix some UI adaptation problems.
-Fix an error about merging turrets which has Seaweed Ball prefix, which could make game crashed.
-Fix problem that Auto-Learning Chip’s bonus cannot be inherited.
-Fix problems that some achievements, like Newbie Guide,  cannot be unlocked.
-Fix mistakes of Noticed Atmosphere’s effective range.
-Fix error of UI of Boss Cyborg Slime, which could make game crashed.
-Fix a bug of Gold Magazine, which could make game crashed.
-Change min speed of Boss Eternal Sphere, which is from 0.5 to 0.1.
-Fix a bug of Multi-Functional Copier, which could make game crashed.
-Fix an error that game crashes when Diamond Spawner is deployed but there is now available path.
-Fix bugs which can make game crashes instantly after game is open.
-Game auto-saves when entering battle.
-Fix problem that Kettle has no effect on acid damage.
-Fix problem that Armament Upgrade cannot be unlocked.
-Fix problem that Invisible Dagger is still effective when unequipping.
...

If you have suggestion or problems and would like to improve quality of Variable2, feel free to talk in steam community. Any feedback is welcomed!

If you purchased our last game Variables before July 1, 2021, Variables2 was automatically added into your library. 

PS: Here is FQA part because we found that some players have problems of operating(Yeah, we all know that is blame to bad UI design). We are sorry for that and we are planning to fix those problems. 

Q: I think the construct was deployed on wrong place. Can I remove them and redeploy?
A: Click right mouse button and you will remove a construct to your inventory. Nexus and spawners can be removed unlimitedly. While platforms, grounds, elevators, turrets can be removed only in the same wave of deploying. For those are deployed during former waves, they cannot be removed.(but you can destroy deployed turrets that you are not satisfied)

Q: I only can use Q and E to rotate camera? That is not convenient.
A: You can drag with middle mouse button to rotate camera.

Q: It seems that achievements has their own reward but I never gained them.
A: You need to click those unlocked achievements icon in handbook to gain your reward. We plan to change that because it is dumb.

Q: The jackpot is always Cross Flipped, no matter how I refresh prize pool.
A: Maybe you have unlocked all upgrades, so there is only Cross Flipped in jackpot pool.

Q: Is the highest difficulty N7?
A: There are EX difficulties in this game, maybe you should try to play endless mode in N7? We prepared surprise when you finish some waves.
